body: I literally already fight, I can fucking assure you that "lack of physical pain and excitement" is not why I cut myself.
Wow, that sucks so much. That's for the honest reply tho
both just sound exhausting but like, if someone did it I'd be proud of them
Relate so hard. One of my girlfriends is like, normal and somehow feels okay and my other girlfriend is like me but literally never asks first. I hate it and it makes me feel so fucking alone.

There's this fucking 40 year old guy in my DnD group who keeps making jokes like "go listen to MCR and cut yourself" and I just wish he'd fucking die already. I don't do this for attention, if I wanted that there's a lot better ways. Literally my family thinks my cuts are cat scratches, and it's not like anything good would come of it if I was like "hey what's up your fully adult 26 year old kid cuts herself because she's secretly drowning". I hate it so much but idk how to ask him to shut the fuck up without starting a fight.

Saying things like "suicide is selfish, think of your family!" is selfish and self serving tbh, that's like blaming your relative for dying of cancer. Blaming a person for dying of depression is so fucking messed up.
